title: fix(runtime)!: bind a resume approval to the screen it was given on
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97D7Wgrpc6gdethzLLmCd8N)_

Fixes #34515
Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: an MCP `resume_run` of a declared-gated flow action on a client that is asked in place (form-mode `elicitation`), where the person accepts after the wizard moved on to another screen in the meantime, is now refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and resumes nothing, where it resumed the screen the run had moved on to. Widened beside it: `ActionConfirmationHandOff.run.screenNodeId` and `ActionResumeRequest.screenNodeId` are new optional keys, and a host call that omits `screenNodeId` behaves as before.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches what a second resume of one run does (`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` lines 211–217 and `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` line 344 teach the hand-off, the `confirm` refusal and the elicitation answers only); `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` gains the rule in this change.

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSKdmdbBugjg8QSZGa

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 交给人确认的 `resume_run` 待办现在记下当时停住的那一屏（`run.screenNodeId`），宿主批准时把它传回 `dispatchActionResume`；流程已经不在那一屏就拒绝（409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`），流程原地不动。在客户端里当场确认的情形同样绑定当屏。
- 为什么改：先在 main 上用真实两屏向导复现了：同一待办批两次、agent 调两次 `resume_run`、用户先在应用里推进后才批，三种情形都把第一屏的值以批准人身份交给了第二屏并直接走完流程（裁决 6942893807，选项 A）。
- 风险与回滚：宿主侧只加可选键，不传 `screenNodeId` 的调用照旧续跑当前屏。唯一变严的一路（BREAKING）：客户端当场确认时，若人点确认前向导已被推进到别的屏，以前会续跑那一屏，现在拒 409、什么都不续跑，agent 需在当前屏重新发起。循环回到同一屏节点的向导仍分不开（已知局限，未见实际用例）。回滚即撤掉本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`（`refuseUnresumableAdmittedRun` 第 5 步的比对、交出待办处写 `screenNodeId`、当场确认分支）、`packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`（`ActionConfirmationHandOff.run.screenNodeId` 与规则 4 散文）、`packages/runtime/src/action-confirmation-handoff-33690.test.ts`（新 `[#34515]` 一组）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/action-confirmation-handoff-33690.test.ts -t 34515`，预期 7 条全绿（4 条拒绝、1 条 400、2 条 CONTROL）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（改了 `packages/spec/src` 契约，先过契约复审）。

## What changes

A multi-screen wizard stays `paused` under the same run id as it moves from screen to screen. The host resume door's step 2 refuses only a run that is no longer paused, so a second resume of one handed-off `resume_run` passed steps 2 to 5 and submitted the first screen's values to the screen the run had moved on to, as the approver. Reproduced on `main` (dc66d330) on a real stack before any code, in all three ways the card names (readings under Verification).

- **Contract** (`@objectstack/spec/contracts`, `ai-service.ts`): `ActionConfirmationHandOff.run` gains the optional `screenNodeId`: the `ScreenSpec.nodeId` the run was parked on when the call was handed off, the screen `values` were given for. Rule 4's prose and the `IActionConfirmationService` docblock say the approval is bound to that screen when the host passes it back, and that a run on another screen is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and stays where it is. The old sentence that left "voiding an item whose run has moved on" to the host is replaced; deciding an item once stays the host's. Rule 4's elicited-`accept` bullet states the same binding for a `resume_run` asked in place: bound to the screen the run was parked on when the person was asked, refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` if the run moved on meanwhile, the run left where it is.
- **Hand-off** (`resumeActionRun`, `domains/mcp.ts`): step 5's helper `refuseUnresumableAdmittedRun` now returns the screen it read, and the hand-off writes its `nodeId` into `run.screenNodeId` (omitted when the engine named none).
- **Host resume door** (`dispatchActionResume` → `resumeActionRunRequest`): `ActionResumeRequest` gains the optional `screenNodeId` (`action-dispatch.ts`). Given, it rides `wiring.hostDoor` into step 5, which refuses a run paused on another screen with `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` before `resume()` is called, so nothing is consumed. A `screenNodeId` that is not a non-empty string is refused `400` before the run is read.
- **Elicited approval** (same function), **BREAKING**: the person answers for the screen the run was parked on when they were asked; if the wizard moved on meanwhile, step 5 refuses the resume `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and nothing resumes. On `main` the same call answered 200 and resumed the screen the run had moved on to, with the values the agent gave for the first one. This is the narrowing the `Clause-②` line declares; the agent asks again on the screen the run is on now. Same defect class, same function, no contract change.
- **Refusal code**: the existing `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / 409, the code step 5 already answers for "paused, but not on a screen". No new code is minted, so the error-code ledger is untouched.
- **N2** (`action-execution.ts`): the enforced-set comment of the confirmation gate now names the host resume door (`dispatchActionResume`) beside the host action door.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`, "Resume a handed-off run as the person who approved it", passes `screenNodeId: handOff.run.screenNodeId` in the example and states the 409, the 400 for a `null`, empty or non-string `screenNodeId`, and the looping-wizard limit.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/34515-resume-approval-bound-to-screen.md`, `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/runtime` patch, with the **BREAKING** paragraph for the elicited path (before and after) and its ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no schema key, value or metadata type moves, and the moved answer is a runtime refusal at the MCP door.
- **Naming**: `screenNodeId` follows `ScreenSpec.nodeId` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`), the id the engine already serves for a parked screen; the seat analysis 6932866004 proposed the same name.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/action-confirmation-handoff-33690.test.ts`: the harness's automation double takes an optional screen list; `resume` moves the run to the next screen (still `paused`, same run id) and completes it after the last. The single-screen default behaves as before. New `describe('[#34515] …')`, seven cases:
  - the same hand-off approved twice: the first resumes `screen_1` (run now on `screen_2`), the second is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `resume` called once, run still on `screen_2`;
  - two `resume_run` calls, two items: approving the second after the first is refused 409;
  - an item approved after the person advanced the wizard in the app: refused 409, `resume` not called;
  - an elicited person who accepts after the wizard moved on meanwhile: refused 409, only the app's resume ran;
  - a `screenNodeId` of `''` or `7`: refused 400 before `getRun`;
  - CONTROL: a single-screen run approved with its screen completes;
  - CONTROL (widening): two approvals passing no screen both resume, as before.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-confirmation-handoff-33690.dogfood.test.ts` (real stack, real automation engine, real MCP over HTTP, the host approval through `dispatchActionResume`): the fixture gains a gated two-screen wizard action and a gated one-screen action; three cases: the same item approved twice (first 200 and the run on `step_2`, second 409 and still on `step_2`), an item approved after the person advanced the wizard through `POST /automation/FLOW/runs/RUN/resume` (409), and CONTROL single screen completes.
- Changed existing assertion (forced): the `[#33690]` case "a resume sent N times resumes 0 times" pins the hand-off with `toEqual`; it now expects `run: { runId, values, screenNodeId: 'screen_1' }`.

## Acceptance notes

- A wizard that loops back to the same screen node cannot be told apart by `nodeId` (option D of the analysis, a pause id from the engine). No flow doing that was found; not filed.
- The binding is opt-in for the host: a call without `screenNodeId` behaves as before. The cloud host must store `run.screenNodeId` with the pending item and pass it back on approval. Cloud half: objectstack-ai/cloud#4549 (comment 6944653166).
- The MCP `resume_run` tool itself (an agent resuming an ungated action) is not bound to a screen: the agent's own call submits to the current screen, as before. Not in this card.
- The step-5 refusal carries no `details` discriminator, matching its sibling ("paused, but not on a screen"); the message names both screens.

## Verification

<details><summary>Reproduction on main (dc66d330), before any code</summary>

Real stack (`bootStack`, `SecurityPlugin`, `MCPServerPlugin`, a confirmation-service double), a gated flow action over a two-screen wizard (`step_1`, `step_2`, both collecting an optional `comment`). The person starts it in the app (REST `/actions`, run paused on `step_1`), the agent calls MCP `resume_run` (handed off), the host approves through `dispatchActionResume` with `confirm: true`:

- (a) same item approved twice: approve #1 → 200, run on `step_2`; approve #2 → 200, run `completed` (`step_2` submitted with step 1's bag).
- (b) agent calls `resume_run` twice (two items, `call 1` / `call 2`): approve item 1 → 200, on `step_2`; approve item 2 → 200, `completed`.
- (c) person advances in the app (`POST /automation/FLOW/runs/RUN/resume`) → on `step_2`; approve the item → 200, `completed`.
- CONTROL: one approval → 200, on `step_2`, still paused.

</details>
